description: Explore source-linked U.S. import notices, official summaries, agencies and evidence topics. Search the public dataset and download the snapshot.
heading: U.S. import updates
intro: Find customs updates, tariff reviews and product investigations by product or country. Read what changed and when.
explorerIntro: Search a product, country or topic to find relevant notices.
sourceLanguage: Notice text is in English. Open the details for the full text and any effective date or comment deadline.
searchPlaceholder: Try aluminum, China, tariff or a document number
emptyText: Try another keyword or clear the filters to see the full snapshot.
noAbstract: No abstract was supplied in this record. Read the official notice for the full text.
topicNote: A notice can match more than one topic. Counts overlap.
methodIntro: The snapshot preserves the original notices and adds a searchable evidence-topic classification. Here is what each part means.
methodSourceText: Notices come from the Federal Register API for CBP, FMC, ITA, USITC and USTR. Every record links to the official publication and its PDF when available.
methodMappingText: Tyllus applies a deterministic keyword taxonomy. Expand a notice to see the exact terms that matched each topic. A topic match is a way to find records; it does not determine whether a notice applies to your shipment.
methodDatesText: Publication dates show when notices appeared in the Federal Register. Effective dates and comment deadlines appear only when the source supplies them. This is a dated snapshot; updates are run on demand.
methodLimitText: This dataset is not a complete inventory of U.S. import requirements. Notices, final rules and proposed rules have different legal effects. Review the official source, its scope and dates before making an operational decision.
downloadIntro: Download the complete snapshot for a spreadsheet, your own analysis or a data catalogue. Search filters do not change these files.
csvText: All notices in a flat table, ready for Excel or Sheets.
jsonText: Full abstracts, dates, official URLs and classification terms.
csvwText: Column descriptions and the CSV schema.
citationText: The 4 October 2026 dataset snapshot is archived on Zenodo. Use the DOI to reference that version; newer website snapshots may differ.
footer: Published by Tyllus. Check the original notice before changing a shipment.
featuredIntro: Fees, importer details and shipment disclosures — open an update to read what it says.

2026-15530.title: Customs user fees: FY 2027 adjustment
2026-15530.summary: CBP announces inflation adjustments to certain customs user fees and their limits for fiscal year 2027.

2026-16911.title: Importer details: increased checks on Form 5106
2026-16911.summary: CBP is increasing checks of importer information. Inaccurate or incomplete details can lead to an importer number being voided.

2026-12670.title: De minimis: suspension for non-postal shipments
2026-12670.summary: The rule suspends the exemption for imports valued at $800 or less arriving outside the international postal network, requiring formal or informal entry.

2026-17926.title: Supply-chain disclosures: CBP seeks comments
2026-17926.summary: CBP is considering new requirements for party details, supply-chain tracing and foreign export documents. This is a proposal, not a new requirement in force.
